tasks.budget: One coherent slice and affected checks; actual host/account budget admitted before execution. No invented dates, estimates or paid-resource allowance.

tasks.title: Enforce Sandbox egress and credential boundaries
tasks.acceptance: Default untrusted execution to deny-all or narrow declared egress; use supported credential brokering so secrets do not enter untrusted code. Test allowed/denied destinations, redaction, revocation and no ambient control-plane/Docker access. Do not label VM allocation as every per-process quota.
tasks.budget: One coherent slice and affected checks; actual host/account budget admitted before execution. No invented dates, estimates or paid-resource allowance.

tasks.title: Model persistent sessions, snapshots and resume semantics
tasks.acceptance: Track filesystem snapshots separately from running process state; version snapshot identity/retention and invoke reviewed startup on resume. Prove stop→resume file continuity, missing/expired snapshot and incompatible source/image behavior without replaying external deployment.
tasks.budget: One coherent slice and affected checks; actual host/account budget admitted before execution. No invented dates, estimates or paid-resource allowance.

tasks.title: Qualify Sandbox cleanup, retention and bounded billing
tasks.acceptance: Actually observe timeout/cancel/provider-failure cleanup, retained/deleted state, permissions and budget stops. Use a reviewed disposable fixture and explicit account spend allowance before a live sandbox/drive run; no indefinite public port or auto-renewing session by default.
tasks.budget: One coherent slice and affected checks; actual host/account budget admitted before execution. No invented dates, estimates or paid-resource allowance.

tasks.title: Publish provider-specific durable-storage capabilities
tasks.acceptance: Separate Function scratch /tmp, object/database storage, Docker named volumes, Kubernetes PVCs, Sandbox filesystem snapshots and Sandbox Drives. Current official Sandbox persistence/Drive offering is not Cooker support; ordinary Functions must not be offered as persistent-disk hosts.

tasks.acceptance: Typed exact resource owner/region/mount/mode/capacity/retention binding and versioned references; reject host-root paths, traversal, unsupported mounts and cross-tenant substitutions. Display configured and observed mounts independently.

tasks.title: Protect storage ownership, regions and concurrent access
tasks.acceptance: Enforce provider-supported single-writer/read-only-snapshot rules, same-region requirements and attachment leases. Test concurrent claims, stale versions, disconnect/revoke, old-schema readers and no silent data recreation.

tasks.title: Prove data survives stop, redeploy and restore
tasks.acceptance: Use checksummed synthetic data across stop/resume/redeploy and reviewed snapshot/backup restore. Record actual data hashes, schema/image identities, failure and recovery. A mounted path or snapshot ID alone does not establish durability.

tasks.title: Implement retention and separately authorized deletion
tasks.acceptance: Stopping a service preserves durable data unless a separately reviewed destructive action says otherwise. Audit retain/delete policy, unknown deletion outcome, recovery window and provider cleanup; test no orphan leakage or cross-service deletion.

tasks.title: Define service telemetry scope, freshness and coverage
tasks.acceptance: Model runtime logs, build/stage logs, metrics and traces separately, bound to exact owner/resource/deployment/replica/time window. Unknown, unsupported, stale, empty and failed states differ. No health derived from deployment READY alone.

tasks.acceptance: Use provider-supported adapters with cursors/time/line/byte limits, replica identity, cancellation, redaction and scoped retention. Prevent account/replica/cross-deployment leakage; keep pipeline logs separate from app runtime logs and exact snapshots immutable.
